From: Kai Jensen <kai.jensen@example.com>
Sent: Wednesday, October 14, 2026 5:40 PM
To: Alex Example <you@example.com>
Cc: Finley Fischer <finley.fischer@example.com>
Subject: RE: FW: Analytics vendor contract renewal
 
Hi Alex,

Thanks for forwarding this. We can hold the current licence price for a two-year term if the order is signed by October 30, and we'll put support back on Standard.

One heads-up: the data retention add-on moves to per-TB pricing next year. At your current volume it works out about the same.

I'll send a revised order form tomorrow.

Best,
Kai
